criterion: Account Settings: Updating and saving the company "Name" in "Account Settings" does not update the company name displayed in the top bar.

forms.page_or_workflow: Top bar → User Profile (avatar icon - top-right corner) → Account Settings (option) → Settings (dialog) → Company info (section) → Name → Edit (action) → Edit name (dialog) → Enter name (field) → (Enter company name) → Save → Done → Top bar → "Aequus LLC" → (Previous company name not updated)
forms.reproduction_steps:
1. Go to Top bar.
2. Access the "User Profile" menu (avatar icon - top-right corner).
3. Click on the "Account Settings" option from the "User Profile" menu.
4. Click on the "Name" edit action under the "Company info" section in the "Settings" dialog.
5. Enter the company name.
6. Click on the "Save" button to save the changes.
7. Observe that updating and saving the company "Name" in "Account Settings" does not update the company name displayed in the top bar.
forms.expected_behavior: After updating and saving the company name in Account Settings, the top bar should display the updated company name.
forms.actual_behavior: The company name is successfully updated and saved in Account Settings, but the top bar continues to display the previous company name, "Aequus LLC".

forms.reproduction_steps:
